name: BloodPressureViewSqlView
description: Blood pressure readings with a DATE-typed effective_date, so the SQL-on-FHIR example Library can compare it against a date parameter.

extension.valueString:
-- SQLView dependency for the SQL-on-FHIR example Library
-- Library-SqlOnFhirExample.json.
--
-- The IG query compares `blood_pressure_view.effective_date` against a
-- `date` parameter, so the dependency must expose a real DATE column.
-- A ViewDefinition emits temporal columns as VARCHAR (fixture-pinned: the
-- official spec_tests assert string equality for date/dateTime), so this
-- dependency is materialized as a SQLView instead of a ViewDefinition and
-- casts explicitly.
SELECT
  json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_id,
  TRY_CAST(json_extract(r.resource, '$.component[0].valueQuantity.value') AS DOUBLE) AS systolic,
  TRY_CAST(json_extract(r.resource, '$.component[1].valueQuantity.value') AS DOUBLE) AS diastolic,
  TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.effectiveDateTime') AS DATE) AS effective_date
FROM resources AS r
WHERE r.resourceType = 'Observation'
  AND json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') = '85354-9'
